hooks.command: IN=$(cat); if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/directive_recall.py"; fi

IN=$(cat); if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/directive_prefilter.py"; then printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/directive_recall.py"; fi

hooks.statusMessage: MemHub: checking directives for this failure
hooks.command: IN=$(cat); if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/reactive_prefilter.py"; then printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/directive_recall.py"; fi

IN=$(cat); case "$IN" in *git*commit*|*"gh pr"*) if [ -z "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then echo "[memhub-flush] CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT unset; cannot locate flush scripts, skipping" >&2; elif printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/flush_prefilter.py"; then printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/flush_session.py"; fi ;; esac

hooks.statusMessage: MemHub: PR created — arming babysit loop
hooks.command: IN=$(cat); case "$IN" in *gh*pr*create*) if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/pr_babysit_trigger.py"; fi ;; esac
IN=$(cat); if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/capture_health.py"; fi

IN=$(cat); if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/turn_flush_prefilter.py"; then printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/flush_turn.py"; fi
IN=$(cat); if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/flush_session.py"; fi
